title: Drag the window wider, then taller (live): the grid follows the window and the scrollback stays at the prompt
why: Dogfood v1 (Lawrence 2026-10-27, "resizing window makes terminal looks buggy"): a window growing while the terminal shows the bottom of a long scrollback scrolled the terminal into its history, further at each grow step (TerminalScroller took AppKit's clip clamp as a knob drag; test 33cd577dcd8, fix 673587c97dc). Checked while the button is still held (in the live resize), not only after.
source: dogfood bug v1 (Lawrence), window life: resize by drag

steps.title: set-up: the window at 55% x 50% of the screen, top left
the terminal fits the placed window
a long scrollback, the prompt at the bottom
press the bottom-right corner and drag 300 points right (button held)
mid-drag, wider: the grid follows, the prompt stays in view
keep the button held and drag 220 points down
mid-drag, taller: more rows, the scrollback does not jump into its history
a last grow step, then release
after the drag: the PTY has the window's grid, the prompt is at the bottom
